title: French Royal Potato Cakes
description: Delicate French-style potato cakes with a delicate floral twist. Serve as a side dish or snack for your next dinner party.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, floral, and babka crumbs.
In a separate bowl, mix royal butter with a pinch of salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop out potato mixture and shape into patties.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add a small amount of oil.
Add potato patties and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the patties to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, until crispy.
